plants.name: Monty the Monstera
plants.notes: Loves bright, indirect light. Wipe the big leaves once a month.

plants.name: Spike
plants.notes: Basically immortal. Too much water is the only way to hurt it.

plants.name: Basil Brush
plants.notes: Pinch the top leaves so it grows bushy. Great on pizza.

plants.name: Fernando
plants.notes: Likes the steam from the shower. Keep the soil a little moist.

plants.name: Sunny
plants.notes: Turns to follow the sun. Needs at least 6 hours of light.
